inlines.v: DIVERS, adjective S as z. [Latin , to turn.] 1. Different; various. Thou shalt not sow thy fields with divers seeds. Deuteronomy 21:1. Nor let thy cattle gender with divers kinds. Leviticus 19:1. [This is now generally written diverse.] 2. Several; sundry; more than one, but not a great number. We have divers examples of this kind. [This word is not obsolete even in common discourse, and is much used in law proceedings.]
